ProductId: B0040K41MY
Summary: Gluten Free Organic Vanilla Cereal

Text: This cereal has a nice crunch to it. When you soak it in milk, all the different parts soften to around the same level, so you don't have that one hard little kernel of a piece that sticks in your teeth.

Further, it tastes good. Sweet, but not obnoxiously so, this is a mighty pleasant cereal.

It's the kind of cereal that you would gladly introduce to a friend or invite to visit you in a cabin you've rented

Text: As luck had it, this cereal arrived the week I had 6 family members visiting - running the gamut from ages 7 - 82. Most had at least one bowl, and it was well received.

I like the fact that it is quite light as cereals go. Very flavorful, seemed to hold up to milk well, and did not leave an overly full feeling

ProductId: B0040K41MY Summary: Very Nice Gluten Free Cereal Text: Very nice breakfast cereal; still maintains a great crunch when mixed with plain yogurt (my favorite way of eating it).

Most important, this cereal is gluten free. There are so few gluten free ready-to-eat cereals on the market. This one gets an A+.
